answer: Each account's rewards can vest in escrow for twenty epochs, while a public beacon picks a fixed share of accounts every epoch for a deep audit of recent graded work. A failed audit burns that account's whole unvested balance. An honest agent risks one pile; a farm of n fakes keeps n piles exposed, and since clones share habits, one caught account flags its kin. Auditors mark reused phrasing in violet, so even a faint ember of copied style links clones, and no reward sits in umber shadow long enough to cash out early.
